description: Trạng thái — ETL-derived (Sửa 2026-10-01 theo BA STT 5): start = COALESCE(Start Date; kỳ thanh tra từ ngày), end = COALESCE(End Date; kỳ thanh tra đến ngày); cả 2 NULL→Chưa thực hiện; có start và (end NULL hoặc end > ngày ETL)→Đang thực hiện; có start và end ≤ ngày ETL→Đã hoàn thành. Giá trị phụ thuộc ngày ETL (sysdate trong SQL BA) — cần nạp lại hằng ngày
etl_logic: INNER JOIN inspection_team ON inspection_team.inspection_team_id = inspection_team_target.inspection_team_id AND inspection_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_INSPECTION_TEAM' AND inspection_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → CASE WHEN COALESCE(inspection_team.start_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_from_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inspection_team.end_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_to_dt) IS NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(inspection_team.start_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_from_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inspection_team.end_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_to_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inspection_team.end_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_to_dt) > :etl_date THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(inspection_team.start_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_from_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inspection_team.end_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_to_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inspection_team.end_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_to_dt) <= :etl_date THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN COALESCE(inspection_team.start_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_from_dt) IS NULL AND COALESCE(inspection_team.end_dt, inspection_team.inspection_period_to_dt) IS NULL THEN 'NOT_STARTED' END
